detail: Third watchdog (~3hr after primary, ~1.5hr after watchdog2) re-checked for Daily Job Report email from onservicetitan.com dated today (2026-10-06). Still zero results via outlook_email_search (sender=onservicetitan.com, afterDateTime=2026-10-06T00:00:00). Confirmed connector works: broad sender-only search (newest-first, no date filter) returns 110 total ServiceTitan emails; the newest batch is still dated 2026-10-05 ~12:01-12:08 UTC (includes Daily Job Report, Daily Materials Vs. Invoice Report, All Estimates - Daily, etc.) -- nothing from onservicetitan.com has arrived since then. Primary (scheduled), watchdog1, and watchdog2 independently found the same gap earlier today. Stopping per Step 1 instructions without running daily_sync.js -- no email means no data to sync. Now 4 independent runs today confirming the same gap; likely a stalled/failed ServiceTitan scheduled export job, not a mail delivery or connector issue on this end.
